senses.gloss: (b. h.) to cover, hide.—Part. pass. (fr. חבה) חָבוּי, f. חֲבוּיָה.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">Cant. R. to II, 1</cite> (play on <he>ח̇ב̇צ̇ל̇ת</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">ib.</cite>) <he>ח̇ב̇ויה בצ̇ל̇ן של מצרים</he> hidden (disregarded) in the shade of Egypt; <he>ח׳ בצלו של ים</he> nearly covered up by the darkness of the Sea; <he>ח׳ בצלו של סיני</he> nearly covered up by the shade of Sinai (threatening to fall upon me) &c.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שח׳ בְצֵלָהּ</he> its (the young lily’s) onion is hidden (its leaves not being unfolded).—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>כל מתי … חֲבוּיִים בי</he> all the dead of the world are buried in me (the earth).
<cite ref="Shabbat 60a:9">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>היו נֶחְבָּאִין וכ׳</he> they hid in a cave.

senses.gloss: to hide. Taan. l. c. they named him חנן הנחבא מפני שה׳ עצמו Ms. M. (ed. שהיה מַחְבִּיא) because he hid himself (in his modesty). Y. Kil. V, 30ᵃ top (play on בתי כְלָאִים, Is. XLII, 22) בית שמַחְבִּיאִין … כִּלְאַיִם a garden house in which it is permitted to keep plants of a different species (from the surrounding vines).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 34b">Sot. 34ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="N00470"><he>נחבי</he></cite>) <he>שה׳ וכ׳</he> he hid (suppressed) the word of God (truth); Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 6 <he>שה׳ את דבריו</he> he suppressed the words he ought to have said; <cite ref="Sotah 34b">ib.</cite> Haăz. 7. [Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) <he>מחבי חביים</he>, read: <he>מחבר חברים</he>, v. <cite ref="H00107"><he>חָבַר</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 9">Midr. Prov. ch. IX</cite>; Tanḥ. Ki Thabo 2 <he>מִתְחַבְּאִים</he> trying to hide themselves.
